description: Candidate classical Ni-Al potentials and future LAMMPS benchmark design.

pun_mishin_2009.potential_name: Purja Pun and Mishin (2009) Ni-Al EAM
pun_mishin_2009.authors: G. P. Purja Pun and Y. Mishin
pun_mishin_2009.citation: G. P. Purja Pun and Y. Mishin (2009), 'Development of an interatomic potential for the Ni-Al system', Philosophical Magazine 89(34-36), 3245-3267.
pun_mishin_2009.fitting_scope: Binary Ni-Al potential built on established pure Al and pure Ni descriptions; cross interaction fitted to experimental cohesive energy, lattice parameter, and elastic constants of B2-NiAl plus ab initio formation energies of several real or hypothetical intermetallic compounds; intended for Ni-Al phases, heterophase interfaces, and mechanical behavior.
pun_mishin_2009.implementation_notes: LAMMPS eam/alloy conversion produced by Chandler Becker (13 Aug 2009) from the authors' plt tabulated functions; reference updated from in-press status on 15 Dec 2009.

mishin_2004_ipr2.citation: Y. Mishin (2004), 'Atomistic modeling of the gamma and gamma'-phases of the Ni-Al system', Acta Materialia 52(6), 1451-1467.

superseded_ipr1.rejection_reason: The ipr1 file has non-zero isolated-atom energies: bulk potential energies are correct but do not correspond to cohesive energies. The corrected ipr2 file explicitly sets the zero-density embedding value F(rho=0)=0 so isolated atoms have zero energy.

mishin_2004_ipr2.fitting_scope: Ni-Al potential developed primarily for the gamma (Ni solid solution) and gamma-prime (Ni3Al) phases; fitted to experimental and first-principles data for lattice properties, point defects, planar faults, and phase-diagram characteristics; narrower intended composition scope than the 2009 general binary potential.
mishin_2004_ipr2.implementation_notes: Only the corrected ipr2 implementation is accepted for this project. Project formation energies are still calculated from consistently relaxed bulk elemental references, never from isolated atoms.
known_warnings: The superseded ipr1 implementation (NiAl.eam.alloy) must not be used; it has non-zero isolated-atom energies.

mishin_2002.potential_name: Mishin, Mehl, and Papaconstantopoulos (2002) B2-NiAl EAM
mishin_2002.authors: Y. Mishin, M. J. Mehl, and D. A. Papaconstantopoulos
mishin_2002.citation: Y. Mishin, M. J. Mehl, and D. A. Papaconstantopoulos (2002), 'Embedded-atom potential for B2-NiAl', Physical Review B 65(22), 224114.
mishin_2002.fitting_scope: Historical EAM optimized for the B2 phase of NiAl, fitted to experimental properties and ab initio data for multiple crystal structures; accurately reproduces basic B2-NiAl lattice properties, planar faults, and point-defect characteristics.
mishin_2002.implementation_notes: LAMMPS eam/alloy conversion produced by Chandler Becker (14 Feb 2009) from the authors' plt tabulated functions; historical model-generation comparison role, not the primary production recommendation. Age alone is not treated as proof of lower accuracy.
known_warnings: NIST documentation cautions that the elemental descriptions taken from this B2-optimized alloy fit may perform poorly for pure Ni, pure Al, and non-B2 Ni-Al phases; this directly affects formation-energy transferability across the five selected compositions.
